title: Cross-Loss Influence Functions to Explain Deep Network Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating word embeddings using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure the effect size of bias by computing differences in mean cosine similarities between gender target words and attributes like career, math, and art.

Evaluating word embeddings using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure the effect size of bias by computing differences in mean cosine similarities between racial target words (e.g., European-American vs. African-American names) and pleasant/unpleasant attributes.
Investigating hidden influential concepts using a modified WEAT to identify spurious correlations between religious terms and unpleasant attributes or racial groups.
